ja: あのとき予約してれば、今ごろ沖縄でのんびりなのにね。
en: If we'd booked back then, we'd be lounging in Okinawa now.
alternatives: If we'd booked back then, we'd be relaxing in Okinawa now.
If only we'd booked, we'd be chilling in Okinawa right now.
point: 過去の条件と今の結果は if 節が過去完了、主節が would be

ja: 言ってくれてたら、集合を遅らせられたのに。
en: If you'd told us, we could've met later.
alternatives: If you'd said something, we could've pushed it back.
We could've met later if you'd told us.
point: 「言ってくれてたら」は had + 過去分詞、帰結は could have

ja: 弟は、姉の結婚式に休みを取ればよかったと悔やんでる。
en: My brother wishes he'd taken time off for the wedding.
alternatives: My brother regrets not taking time off for the wedding.
My brother wishes he'd requested time off for the wedding.
point: 主語が三人称なら wishes、後悔の中身は過去完了

ja: 幹事に頼んで、同窓会を遅らせてもらったよ。
en: I got the organizer to push the reunion back.
alternatives: I had the organizer push the reunion back.
I got the organizer to put the reunion off.
point: get 人 to do と have 人 do、to の有無に注意

ja: 雨でピクニックが延期になったよ。
en: The picnic was postponed because of rain.
alternatives: The picnic got postponed due to rain.
The picnic was put off because of rain.
point: ピクニックが主語なので was postponed の受け身

ja: ごめん、疲れてるから行けないよ。
en: Sorry, I can't come. I'm tired.
alternatives: Sorry, I'm too tired to come.
Sorry, I'm too tired to go.
point: 「行けない」は can't come、理由は短い文で足す

ja: 土曜、何時に集合だっけ？
en: What time are we meeting Saturday?
alternatives: What time do we meet Saturday?
When are we meeting on Saturday?
point: 予定の集合は are we meeting と進行形で言える

ja: 父は来月、大学の友人と会うんだ。
en: My dad's meeting college friends next month.
alternatives: My dad's getting together with friends next month.
Dad's catching up with college friends next month.
point: 決まっている予定は現在進行形 is meeting で言える

ja: サラの電話の時、予定を立ててたよ。
en: I was making plans when Sarah called.
alternatives: Sarah called while I was making plans.
I was planning things when Sarah called.
point: していた最中は過去進行形、電話は過去形 called

ja: 駅の近くのカフェで会おうよ。
en: Let's meet at the café near the station.
alternatives: How about the café near the station?
Let's meet at the café by the station.
point: 「駅の近くの」は near the station を名詞の後ろに置く

ja: 無理なら、せめて前日に言ってくれればよかったのに。
en: You should've at least told me the day before.
alternatives: You could have let me know the day before.
You might have told me a day earlier.
point: 「〜すればよかったのに」は should have + 過去分詞

ja: 急で悪いけど、ランチを日曜にずらせたりしない？
en: Sorry, any chance we could push lunch to Sunday?
alternatives: Sorry, could we possibly move lunch to Sunday?
Sorry, would it work to move lunch to Sunday?
point: 控えめな頼みは Any chance we could で始める。ずらすは push

ja: 日曜日に映画を見に行こう。
en: Let's see a movie Sunday.
alternatives: Let's go to a movie Sunday.
Let's watch a movie on Sunday.
point: 「見に行こう」は Let's see a movie でOK

ja: 都合が悪いのは週末全部じゃなくて、日曜の朝だけなんだ。
en: It's just Sunday morning that doesn't work, not the weekend.
alternatives: Only Sunday morning is a problem, not the whole weekend.
What doesn't work for me is Sunday morning, not the weekend.
point: 強調したい「日曜の朝」を It's と that で挟む

ja: 日程、全員が空いてる日がやっと見つかったよ。
en: We've finally found a day that works for everyone.
alternatives: We've finally found a date that suits everyone.
We've finally found a day everyone is free.
point: 「やっと見つかった」は現在完了。day を that で後ろから説明

ja: 姉が、旅行のこと、もう決めたかって聞いてるよ。
en: My sister's asking if you've decided yet.
alternatives: My sister wants to know if you've decided yet.
My sister's wondering whether you've made up your mind.
point: if の後は you've decided の平叙文の語順にする

ja: 夕食に友達二人連れてきていい？
en: Mind if I bring two friends to dinner?
alternatives: Is it okay if I bring two friends?
Can I bring two friends to dinner?
point: 相手のいる場所へ「連れてくる」は take でなく bring

ja: 悪いけど、必要なのは家でのんびりする時間。
en: Sorry, what I need is downtime at home.
alternatives: Sorry, what I need is time to relax.
Sorry, I just need some downtime at home.
point: 「〜なのは」は What I need is で始める

ja: 引っ越しの手伝い、友達にあと何人か頼むね。
en: I'll ask a few more friends to help.
alternatives: I'll get a few more friends to help.
I'll ask a few other friends to pitch in.
point: ask 人 to do の形。help の前に to を忘れない

ja: 今めちゃ忙しいし、金曜の飲み会は休もうかな。
en: I'm swamped, so I'm thinking of skipping Friday's drinks.
alternatives: I've been so busy that I'm considering skipping Friday's drinks.
I'm slammed, so I'll probably skip Friday's drinks.
point: think of の後は -ing 形。to skip にしない

ja: 姉が、夕食は行けないって言ってたよ。
en: My sister said she couldn't make dinner.
alternatives: My sister said she couldn't come to dinner.
My sister told me she couldn't make dinner.
point: 過去の発言なので can't ではなく couldn't に時制をそろえる

ja: 兄は毎週土曜に練習があるよ。
en: My brother has practice every Saturday.
alternatives: My brother has practice on Saturdays.
My brother practices every Saturday.
point: 主語が三人称単数なので have ではなく has

ja: 兄は、父が退院するまで帰省できないって。
en: My brother can't come home until Dad gets discharged.
alternatives: My brother can't come home till Dad's released.
My brother can't make it home until Dad's discharged.
point: until 節の中は未来のことでも現在形（gets）

ja: 母が、夕食は6時に変わったって言ってた。
en: Mom said dinner had been moved to six.
alternatives: Mom told me dinner had been moved to six.
Mom said they'd moved dinner to six.
point: said の後は時制を一つ過去へ（had been moved）

ja: 兄に誘われた時、もう予定を入れてた。
en: I'd already made plans when he asked.
alternatives: When he asked, I'd already made plans.
I'd already made plans when he invited me.
point: 誘われた時点より前の予定は had made の過去完了

ja: 車があったら、送ってあげられるのに。
en: If I had a car, I'd drive you.
alternatives: I'd drive you if I had a car.
If I had a car, I'd take you.
point: 実際にはない車の仮定は had、帰結は I'd（would）で表す

ja: 私たち、旅行の日程をもう三回変えたよ。
en: We've already changed our dates three times.
alternatives: We've rescheduled our trip three times already.
We've moved our trip dates three times already.
point: 「もう三回変えた」は過去形でなく現在完了で言う

ja: 雨でも中止にせず、うちに集まろうよ。
en: Rain or shine, let's still get together at my place.
alternatives: Even if it rains, let's still meet at my place.
Even if it rains, let's still get together at mine.
point: 「雨でも」は rain or shine か even if。even if 節は現在形

ja: 雨予報だし、キャンプは延期しない？
en: Rain's forecast, so how about putting camping off?
alternatives: Rain's forecast, so why not postpone camping?
With rain forecast, how about postponing camping?
point: how about の後は動詞の -ing 形（putting off）

ja: ケンに、何時に出発か聞いてもらえる？
en: Could you ask Ken when we're leaving?
alternatives: Can you ask Ken what time we leave?
Could you check with Ken when we're leaving?
point: when の後は we're leaving の語順で、疑問文の語順にしない

ja: 弟は一週間ずっと旅行を計画してるよ。
en: My brother's been planning our trip all week.
alternatives: He's been planning our trip for a week.
He's been planning the trip all week long.
point: 今も続く行動は has been planning、期間は all week など
